test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An apple tree is taller than a lemon tree. A papaya tree is shorter than a palm tree. A mango tree is shorter than the papaya tree but taller than apple tree. Which is the tallest tree?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) An apple tree is taller than a lemon tree.

⇒ **Apple** tree > Lemon tree

2) A papaya tree is shorter than a palm tree

⇒ **Papaya** tree < Palm tree</p&g
